dedupe_keys.name: polysun district heating software simulation of heat supply systems and district heating networks vela solaris commercial

description: Polysun, from Vela Solaris AG in Winterthur, is commercial simulation software that its district heating page presents for detailed simulation of complex heat supply systems. It models energy flows in district heating networks and the integration of renewable heat, combining generation components such as heat pumps, geothermal probes, combined heat and power, waste heat and solar, and supports virtual testing of control strategies. The page lists heat loss calculation in distribution pipes, CO2 emission calculation to compare how designs contribute to decarbonisation, economic analysis covering investment, operation, component lifetimes and possible funding, and comparison of multiple system variants, and it names low-temperature fourth and fifth generation networks that move heat at ambient temperature. A trial version is offered; licences are paid and prices are not published on the page read. Coverage is any modelled system. Caveats: the page does not state the deployment form or data formats, and results come from proprietary models. Simulation uses are design and control testing of district heating plants and low-temperature networks in heat planning studies. Related records: platform-npro-district-energy-planning is a browser-based alternative.
